label: Nokia XR20 rugged smartphone
description: Nokia XR20 — 6.67-inch ruggedised phone (MIL-STD-810H, IP68), Wi-Fi 6 and 5G sub-6 GHz; USB-C 3.0 with Ethernet over adapter.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz) — HMD's spec sheet lists 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz (Snapdragon 480 5G), LTE Cat 15 fallback, no mmWave. USB-C 3.0 with OTG and Ethernet adapter support (usb0). Field/industrial endpoint: expect it to stay associated at weak RSSI (-85 dBm) far longer than a glass-backed flagship, which is the interesting roaming contrast.
